title: Inline photo notes and the rich markdown editor

completion_criteria.text: The four rich-editor audits (prototype editor, app capture/storage, package landscape, single-TextField substrate limits) are complete, cited, and committed under docs/specs/research/
The editor substrate architecture is decided and recorded as a decision record with its rejected alternatives and pre-mortem
A detailed spec covering BOTH the rich markdown editor AND OQ-6 exists, orders the editor strictly before OQ-6, and resolves every unreachable value at spec time
The existing P0-P5 inline-photo ladder has been re-read against the no-wrap-in-EditableText limit and either amended or explicitly re-affirmed
The spec is implemented via mitosis, every MSP leaving note capture working on its own merge commit
No schema migration was required, or one shipped as its own MSP with a successful-upgrade test and a rollback proven on a copy of a real journal

spine.active_goal: Ship the rich markdown editor (E0-E7), then OQ-6's inline anchored photos (P0-P5) -- one controller seam, editor first, no schema migration. The combined spec (docs/specs/2026-08-03-rich-editor-and-inline-photos.md, branch inline-photo/spec, 62da2cb) is the standing AUTHORITY and citation source. It is NOT dispatchable as-is: the convergence pass returned NOT READY. Execution slices must be cut from it per decision 0006.
spine.next_step: DO NOT DISPATCH YET. Convergence pass (3 reviewers) returned NOT READY with 6 blockers. Fix in this order: (1) declare the TYPES -- MarkdownBlock, the inline node type, and all five function signatures; nothing in 840 lines declares one type and all 14 phases consume them; (2) reconcile local main (30 commits behind origin/main); (3) write acceptance criteria for E2/E3/E5/E7; (4) cut the first execution slice (E0+P0+P1) per decision 0006.
open_risks: NO TYPES ANYWHERE. MarkdownBlock is named once, never defined; no function signature is declared. An implementer would invent the model all 14 phases consume. THE single biggest gap -- an E0 simulation could not ship from the spec alone.

E0's test count is self-contradictory: spec 3.1 says criteria 1-3 run once per row (12 rows = 36 cases), spec 6 and 8 say 6 cases. Section 8 forbids absorbing a mismatch, so this must be resolved before E0.
Criterion 2's '200 generated documents' has NO generator contract, seed, or determinism clause. Repo forbids flaky tests and M10 forbids a property-test package. Mandate a fixed seed.
E0's created files are never NAMED (spec 6 says 'all under test/features/entry_cards/markdown/'), yet E1 depends on them by name and 'six files' vs 'six plus the barrel' disagree.

toPlainText() defaults are load-bearing and unstated: includeSemanticsLabels defaults TRUE, so D4/E2's semantics suppression could make N1's whole char-for-char gate VACUOUS. Name the flags in E0's criteria.
E2, E3, E5, E7 have NO acceptance criteria -- only 'Tests it adds: N cases' plus prose. E4 and E6 have one clause each. Mitosis consumes criteria from the document at plan stage.
E1's fileScope is not exhaustive: it ends 'and the four test files those red', unnamed. fileScope completeness is what prevents cross-MSP collision.
Sub-file fences (E2 'controller swap only', E5 'contextMenuBuilder only') are PROSE -- fileScope is path-level and cannot express them. E2/E5/E6 plus P1/P2/P4 all claim text_composer_sheet.dart.

UNSTRUCK CONTRADICTIONS: spec 10.1 says never critic-hardened while 11 says the pass closed; A8 says R0 is spent while A12 says A8 is WRONG; 10.6 still says the substrate is 'proposed' though it was ratified. Mitosis precondition 2 (APPROVED spec) fails while these stand.
Human-gated merge parks every transitive dependent, and 7.2 is a near-linear 14-rung chain -- expect ~12 merge-and-relaunch cycles. Batch-scope it (E0+P0+P1 first), never one dispatch.

Local main is 30 commits BEHIND origin/main and origin/main is NOT its ancestor. Mitosis cuts worktrees from the bare LOCAL main ref. Reconcile first (decision 2026-07-16); gate on git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main main.
The spec is not on any base branch -- it lives only on inline-photo/spec. Merge it or set baseBranch accordingly before dispatch.
The ~60 [inherited] citations in the sibling outside the 28 proven anchors remain UNVERIFIED.
splitSpanAt (A1) is UNSPIKED: asserted tractable, never proven. If P3 finds it harder, that is a finding against A1, not an implementer judgement call.
out_of_scope: OQ-3 (entry-card Edit/Delete placement) — deliberately set aside by the user; still the last open criterion of the separate prototype-design-alignment thread.
Nested lists and indent, links, and custom undo/redo beyond Flutter's built-in UndoHistory — none exist in the prototype to reference.
Any editor package: super_editor, flutter_quill, appflowy_editor, re_editor and flutter_markdown are all rejected on named constraints.
Any database migration or schema change.
Editable text that wraps around an inline object — structurally impossible in Flutter; write mode stays plain.
Arbitrary pixel positioning of photos. The anchor is a position in the text, never an (x, y).
